 Print Income matters keep a generous tone. Jupiter in Leo sits in your 2nd house of income, savings and spending, and its goodwill reaches pay talks, rates and family money. Gains look steady rather than sudden. Jupiter also stretches whatever it touches, so spending can grow as fast as earnings. Ask for what you are owed, and keep a limit in mind. Cancer Career Predictions 
 A rate review, a client payment or a pending bonus may get a friendly hearing. Bring one firm figure and a short record of finished work. A senior could respond to a calm, dated request. Compare any revived term with the earlier email, and confirm each agreed point in writing. Watch You Are on Jupiter's Lucky List? Aries to Pisces: Who Benefits Most from it ?|Ft. Prakash Joshi Cancer Love Predictions 
 Money talk with a partner feels lighter, and generosity comes easily. Talk about the goal before the gift. Couples can agree on a monthly budget and stick to it. A relative may add an opinion, so stay patient. Singles may meet someone who spends freely. Notice how they handle a small bill before you plan more. Cancer Money Predictions

 Income may improve through a client, a rate change or a family contribution. Confirm the figure and the date. Set a daily spending limit before any treat, and move a fixed share into savings first. A refund may arrive with a changed amount, so ask for the breakdown. Skip quick-return offers. Cancer Health Predictions 
 Your mood is good, and your appetite rises with it. The stomach, throat and chest may feel the effect of rich food, so keep portions modest and sip warm water. Keep exercise easy and end the evening early. Cancer Remedies 
 Send one polite, dated message about a pending payment. Rest your neck and shoulders for a few minutes tonight.
